title: Triangle-free graphs of every chromatic number
statement: For every positive integer $k$, there exists a finite simple graph $G$ that contains no triangle and whose chromatic number is exactly $k$.
hypotheses_covered: k is a positive integer (0 < k)
replaced:
(Mycielski, 1955). \emph{For any positive integer \texttt{k}, there exists a
\texttt{k}-chromatic graph containing no triangle.}
